:= by
  let τ_im := τ.im
  let n_abs := n.natAbs
  let exp_arg := ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ
  let exp_real_part := -Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im
  let bound_exp := Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im) ^ n_abs

  have h_norm_exp : ‖Complex.exp exp_arg‖ = Real.exp (Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im) :=
    by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      simp only [Complex.re, Complex.im, Real.pi, Complex.I, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Real.ofReal,
        Real.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_assoc, Real.mul_one, Real.one_mul, Real.add_zero, Real.zero_add]
      exact congrArg Real.exp (eq_neg_neg (Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im))

  have h_exp_ineq : Real.exp (Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im) ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ_im) ^ n_abs :=
    by
      rw [Real.exp_pow]
      have h1 : Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ_im ≤ -Real.pi * τ_im * n_abs :=
        by
          rw [Real.neg_mul, Real.mul_assoc, Real.mul_comm]
          apply Real.le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.pi * τ_im) (Real.le_abs (↑n ^ 2))
          exact Real.pos_of_gt hτ
      exact Real.exp_le_exp h1

  exact h_exp_ineq.trans h_norm_exp.symm
